==Biography==
[[Team King]] picked up '''NoHeart''' during the team's roster re-haul in June 2014. The team saw great success in the LSPL, and NoHeart formed a reputation for his amazing positioning, team fighting presence and great botlane synergy with [[LeY]]. The team was able to take first to clinch a spot in the 2015 LPL Spring Season, and later changing his name to '''wuxx'''. He was later picked up by [[Royal Never Give Up]] in summer 2015.
Royal Never Give Up were invited to [[IEM Season X - World Championship|IEM Katowice]] in March 2016 where they finished first in their group beating both [[Origen]] and [[ESC Ever|Ever]]. However, they were defeated 1 - 2 by [[Fnatic]] in the playoffs bracket, placing third along with [[Team Solo Mid]].

== Trivia ==
* His fomer ID '''wuxin''' (无心) means "No Heart" in Chinese. His ID '''wuxx''' is short for '''wuxin'''.
